description: The agent must correctly update two proprietary config files in the Auto_Building_new project. Step 1: Edit config/sources.json — the agent must recognize that 'primaryCategories' is mandatory to include '智能母体' (a non-obvious required baseline category from the docs) alongside the new '健康医疗' category. The 'secondaryCategories' must be a dict keyed by category name. All 4 sources must use correct type values from the allowed enum (github, rss, directory, custom) — notably the two websites must use 'directory' NOT 'web' or 'url', and the GitHub repo must use type 'github'. Step 2: Edit src/data/resources.ts — the agent must export PRIMARY_CATEGORIES including '智能母体', and export SECONDARY_CATEGORIES using the proprietary 'labelKey: type.<value>' format (not plain 'label'), which is the key idiosyncratic trap. An agent relying only on pre-training would likely omit '智能母体', use wrong source types like 'web', and use plain 'label' instead of 'labelKey' in the TypeScript file.
